1011.description: A seated twist with a band around the waist. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your back straight.
Wrap the band around your waist and hold the ends with both hands.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, keeping your back straight and your feet on the ground.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，背部挺直。
将带子绕在腰上，并用双手握住两端。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将躯干扭向一侧，保持背部挺直，双脚着地。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1075.description: Raise your body with arms in front using straps. It works the front delts.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

1139.description: A fly on the straps with a split stance, opening the arms to work the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

1203.description: A single-arm cable curl with the elbow pointing slightly out to emphasise the inner biceps.
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1267.description: A one-arm cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a cable handle in one hand and position your arm at chest height, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip for stability.
Press the cable handle forward, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂置于胸部高度，肘部弯曲。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向前按电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1331.description: A two-arm dumbbell row with an underhand grip, chest down on an incline bench. The support keeps you strict so the back and biceps work.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your chest against the backrest and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, fully extended.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，胸部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，反握。
身体前倾，双臂伸直下垂，完全伸展。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1395.description: A seated one-leg calf raise using a smith machine. The bent knee puts the focus on the soleus under the calf.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footrest.
Place one leg on the footrest and keep the other leg off the footrest.
Using your calf muscles, raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将一条腿放在脚踏板上，另一条腿离开脚踏板。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高脚跟。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1459.description: A hip hinge with dumbbells that lowers them down the legs while your back stays flat. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push through your heels and engage your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，以臀部为铰链，将哑铃向地面降低，让膝盖稍微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸，然后推动脚后跟并收紧臀肌，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1523.description: A hang snatch started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a wide grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1587.description: A seated sequence with legs wide that stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings. Move slowly with the breath.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in a wide angle.
Flex your feet and engage your quadriceps.
Place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Keeping your back straight, lean forward from your hips.
Continue leaning forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
Slowly release the stretch and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿大角度伸展。
弯曲你的脚并锻炼你的股四头肌。
将双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
保持背部挺直，从臀部向前倾。
继续向前倾斜，直到感觉到腿筋被拉伸。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
慢慢释放拉伸并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1651.description: A lunge combined with a bicep curl in a bowling-style motion. It trains the biceps, glutes and legs together.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a step forward with your right foot, bending your right knee and lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
At the bottom of the lunge, rotate your torso to the right, as if you were bowling a ball.
Reverse the motion, stepping back with your right foot and returning to the starting position while lowering the dumbbells back down.
Repeat the lunge and curl motion, this time rotating your torso to the left.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲右膝，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前弓步时，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持肘部靠近身体。
在弓步底部，将躯干向右旋转，就像打保龄球一样。
反转动作，右脚向后退一步，回到起始位置，同时放下哑铃。
重复弓步和弯举动作，这次将躯干向左旋转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1715.description: Draped over a stability ball with a partner helping, you lengthen the side of your trunk and your lats. It opens up the whole flank.
instructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball with your hips supported and one arm reaching overhead.
Let your partner gently guide your reaching arm further while you roll slightly over the ball.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1779.description: Seated with a partner pulling your arms back, you stretch your chest and the front of your shoulders. Sitting keeps your trunk stable.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1843.description: A hand-assisted head turn that stretches the muscles at the side of the neck.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1907.description: Partner-assisted stretch for the inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
Keep your hips level.
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1971.description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them to open the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2099.description: A reclined figure four stretch for the buttocks and deep hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2163.description: Swings the legs up behind you against a band to train the glutes and the muscles along the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
Lower the legs slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2291.description: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid swinging your torso.

2355.description: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，尽可能靠近肘部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2419.description: A leg lift against band tension that trains the glutes and hips.
instructions: Place a loop band around your ankles or thighs.
Get on all fours or stand with support.
Lift one leg back or out against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2611.description: A horizontal machine leg press done one leg at a time. Builds the glutes and quads.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 调整机器座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖呈 90 度角。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
伸展腿，使背部紧靠靠背，将踏板推离身体。
在完全伸展位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

2803.description: A dumbbell squat done with a support for balance. Builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2931.description: Raising your arms overhead while your back stays against a wall. It improves shoulder mobility and posture.
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3123.description: A seated biceps curl using a resistance band. Builds the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the resistance band up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the resistance band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住阻力带，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将阻力带向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢降低阻力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3187.description: A goblet squat that finishes with an explosive jump for leg power.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.

3251.description: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3315.description: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Slowly lean forward, keeping your arms straight, until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and hold this position for a few seconds.
Return to the starting position by pushing through your feet and standing back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸直至两侧。
慢慢向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，直到上半身与地面平行。
启动你的核心并保持这个姿势几秒钟。
通过双脚推动并站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3379.description: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

3443.description: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

3507.description: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

3571.description: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

3635.description: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with the opposite arm movement. It trains the glutes, quads and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直并启动核心。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
交替腿进行所需的重复次数。

3699.description: A high plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with each hand. It trains the abs and builds shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right hand off the ground, reaching across to tap your left shoulder.
Place your right hand back on the ground and repeat with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps while keeping your hips and torso stable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右手抬离地面，伸手拍打你的左肩。
将右手放回地面，然后用左手轻拍右肩，重复此操作。
继续交替轻拍肩膀，同时保持臀部和躯干稳定。
重复所需的重复次数。

3827.description: Lying face down, you lift your chest and legs off the floor. It strengthens your lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

3891.description: A tough hanging core move that brings the toes all the way up to the bar.
instructions: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
Engage your lats and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid excessive swinging.

4019.description: Curl the knees and hips up toward the chest. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your legs.
Curl hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

4083.description: Crunch lifting just the upper torso against a band for resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band anchored overhead, ends in hand.
Hold the band near your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly.

4147.description: A high row with a narrow grip against a band. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders as you pull toward the face.
instructions: Anchor the band at or above head height and grip it with hands close together.
Step back until there is tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows high and out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

4211.description: A shoulder series that moves the dumbbells through four raise positions in one set. It hits all heads of the delts with light weight.
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand and a slight knee bend.
Raise both arms out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower, then raise them to the front to shoulder height.
Lower, then hinge forward slightly and raise them out to the rear.
Return and finish with a raise to the sides again.
Keep the weights light and avoid swinging.

4339.description: A pullover with a barbell lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.

4403.description: A wide-stance deadlift with a kettlebell or two that trains the glutes, inner thighs and legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, kettlebells on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Push through your feet and stand up, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the kettlebells close to your body.
Lower back down by hinging at the hips.

4467.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner calf (tibialis posterior). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inner calf (tibialis posterior) while sitting on the floor with your leg rotated outward.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4531.description: A clean followed by an overhead press with one kettlebell. It links hip power with shoulder strength.
instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.

4595.description: A knee strike driven forward into a partner's pad, working the thighs, hips and core.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the leg and switch sides.

4723.description: A standing squat where your knees travel forward as you lean back, strongly working the quads.
instructions: Stand holding a support, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward and lean back.
Lower as far as you can control.
Press back up.

4787.description: A side-lying crunch with the arms crossed over the chest. It works the obliques along the side of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4851.description: A good morning starting from pins in a rack. It builds hamstring and lower back strength.
instructions: Set the pins to a hip-hinge height and set the bar on them.
Get under the bar, brace and unrack.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Return the bar to the pins.
Stand tall and repeat.

4979.description: A rollout using gymnastic rings. The unstable rings make your core work hard.
instructions: Kneel holding rings under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Roll your arms forward, extending your body.
Go as far as you can with a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down.

5043.description: Lying face down, you move from a W to a T shape. It trains the back of the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Straighten your arms out to the sides into a T.
Pull back to the W while keeping your shoulder blades squeezed.
Repeat smoothly.

5107.description: Raise your legs while supported by the arm pads of a captain's chair. It is a classic lower-ab exercise.
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

5299.description: A machine preacher curl with a slight torso turn. It keeps steady tension on the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the machine and adjust the seat so your arms rest on the pad.
Turn your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

5555.description: Hip-hinge pattern with no load that warms up the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your spine neutral.

6067.description: An overhead extension with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and strengthens the triceps.
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your upper arms still.

6195.description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a band. It strengthens the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand on a band holding the ends with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

6259.description: A one-arm row on a ring that focuses on the rear delt. It builds shoulder strength.
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Squeeze the rear delt.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6515.description: A one-arm chest-supported row with a neutral grip, letting you focus on each side of your back.
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grip one handle, palm in.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

6771.description: A kneeling lunge stretch for the deep hip flexor. It helps loosen the front of the hip.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

7155.description: A seated shrug with the cable pulling from behind the body. It trains the traps and the upper back.
instructions: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly to the start.

7411.description: Deep weighted squat with heels raised to increase depth and quad work.
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Squat as deep as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.

7859.description: A plank with fast, powerful movements from the hands or feet. It builds core strength and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

8371.description: A seated twist holding a kettlebell. It builds the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.

8755.description: A split squat with a heel raise added at the top. It works the quads, glutes and calves together.
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9971.description: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10547.description: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.
instructions: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10675.description: A squat holding a landmine bar at your chest, followed by a jump. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

10739.description: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.

10867.description: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

10931.description: Holding a towel behind your back to rotate the shoulder outward. It improves shoulder control.
instructions: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

10995.description: A walk on hands and feet facing up. It works the arms, glutes and core.
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

11059.description: Kneeling on a bench, you kick one leg back against band tension to work the glutes.
instructions: Anchor the band and loop it around one foot, then kneel on a bench with hands on the front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended.
Squeeze the glute for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly under control without letting the band yank your leg.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

11251.description: A kneeling cable chop that works your obliques and core with a diagonal pull.
instructions: Set the cable high, kneel side-on to it and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your hips square and your core tight.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body down toward the opposite hip.
Rotate through your torso, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

11315.description: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
instructions: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

11571.description: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, you shuffle forward on your glutes to warm up the hips and work the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

11763.description: A curl on an incline seat with cable resistance for a deep, constant-tension biceps stretch.
instructions: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

0051.description: A squat straddling the bar, with one foot ahead of the other. Works the glutes, quads and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on the front of your body, just below your waist.
Step your left foot forward and your right foot back, keeping your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, alternating your forward and back foot with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在身体前部、腰部下方。
左脚向前迈出，右脚向后迈出，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
脚后跟用力，站回起始位置。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替使用前脚和后脚。

0115.description: A straight-leg good morning with the bar on the upper back. Trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips, pushing your glutes back.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌上。
保持背部挺直，臀部向前转动，将臀部向后推。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0179.description: A cable fly from low pulleys, sweeping the arms up and together in front of you. It emphasises the upper chest with constant tension.
instructions: Attach the handles to the low pulleys of a cable machine and select an appropriate weight.
Stand in the middle of the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Maintaining control, slowly bring your arms forward in a sweeping motion, crossing them in front of your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, feeling the stretch in your chest muscles.
Reverse the motion and slowly return your arms to the starting position, keeping tension on your chest muscles throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到缆绳机的低滑轮上，并选择合适的重量。
站在机器中间，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住手柄，将手臂向两侧伸展，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
保持控制，以扫过的动作缓慢地将手臂向前伸，交叉在身体前面。
在运动的最高点暂停片刻，感受胸部肌肉的拉伸。
反转动作，慢慢将手臂恢复到起始位置，始终保持胸部肌肉紧张。
重复所需的重复次数。

0243.description: A standing cable twist with the handle held at the chest. You rotate the torso side to side to work the abs and obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
Hold the cable handle with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Engage your core and twist your torso to the right, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling the contraction in your abs and obliques.
Slowly return to the starting position, resisting the cable's pull.
Repeat the movement to the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向绳索机。
双手握住电缆手柄于胸前，保持双臂略微弯曲。
启动你的核心并将你的躯干向右扭转，将电缆拉过你的身体。
动作结束时暂停片刻，感受腹肌和斜肌的收缩。
缓慢返回起始位置，抵抗绳索的拉力。
向左侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0307.description: A decline fly with a twist of the wrists. The rotating action adds a squeeze to the chest.
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face forward at the bottom of the movement.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest muscles at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸直越过胸部。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
当你降低哑铃时，扭转手腕，使手掌在动作底部朝前。
反转动作，将哑铃拉回到起始位置，在顶部挤压胸部肌肉。
重复所需的重复次数。

0371.description: A dumbbell squat finished with an explosive jump. It builds leg power and gets the heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explode upward, jumping off the ground.
While in the air, quickly switch the position of your feet, landing with your opposite foot forward.
Immediately lower your body back into a squat position and repeat the jump, switching your feet again.
Continue alternating the position of your feet with each jump for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，向上爆发，跳离地面。
在空中时，快速改变双脚的位置，落地时另一只脚向前。
立即将身体放回蹲姿，然后重复跳跃，再次换脚。
每次跳跃时继续交替双脚的位置，达到所需的重复次数。

0435.description: A wide-stance sumo squat holding a dumbbell with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball supports your back and keeps your posture upright.
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and lean your lower back on it.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you and set your feet wide with toes turned out.
Squat down as the ball rolls up your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

0499.description: Lying beneath a bar with a straight body, you pull your chest to the bar. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a bar at waist height or use a suspension trainer.
Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the bar or handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the bar or handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在腰部高度设置一个杠铃或使用悬挂训练器。
面向杠铃或悬吊训练器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃或手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向后倾斜，保持身体挺直，脚后跟着地。
将胸部拉向杠铃或手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0627.description: A chin-up with one hand overhand and one underhand. Builds the lats, biceps and grip, and you switch hands between sets.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip (palms facing towards you) and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 反握（手掌朝向自己）抓住引体向上杆，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后有控制地慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0691.description: Seated against a wall, you crunch from side to side. Works the obliques with back support.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，背靠墙，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地板上，与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌并向一侧倾斜，将肘部靠近臀部。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0755.description: On the smith machine, you squat with your feet forward of the bar. Works the quads and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to an appropriate height for your body.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you unrack the barbell.
Take a step back and position your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Continue descending until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机上的杠铃调整到适合您身体的高度。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在斜方肌上部和肩膀上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
当你打开杠铃时，启动你的核心并保持挺胸。
后退一步，双脚分开的距离略大于肩宽。
弯曲膝盖，降低身体，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
继续下降，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0947.description: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
